title: A member who pays for MettleUp Plus and then joins a gym or works at one is never told the Google Play plan keeps charging
what: When a member who bought the monthly or yearly MettleUp Plus later joins a gym that uses MettleUp (or is added as desk staff), the app switches them to free through the gym. The MettleUp Plus page then only says the gym gives every feature free and hides the part about what they bought. Nothing says their Google Play plan is still running and still charged every month or year, for features they now get free.
expected: When a member has a running paid plan and also gets everything free through a gym or staff role, the MettleUp Plus page says so and tells them they can cancel the paid plan in Google Play.
who: paying Plus members who later join a MettleUp gym
how_often: every renewal after they join, once payments are live
fix_line: Show a line on the Plus page when a paid plan runs while the gym already makes it free

title: A Plus payment that is waiting, or a plan that is cancelled or refunded, is only noticed when the app is fully restarted
what: When Google Play says a payment is waiting, the app tells the member that Plus opens when Google Play confirms it. But when Google Play confirms later, the phone part that hears it no longer has anyone to tell, so the app does not open Plus. The app only asks Google Play what the member owns once, when it starts fresh; coming back to the app does not ask again. So a member who paid by a slow method waits until they close the app fully or tap I already paid, and a cancelled or refunded plan stays open until the next fresh start. Buying is not switched on yet, so nobody meets this today.
expected: When Google Play confirms a waiting payment, Plus opens at once, and the app asks Google Play again whenever it comes back to the front.
who: members who buy Plus with a slow payment method, or cancel it
how_often: every waiting payment, once payments are live
fix_line: Pass Google Play's late answers to the app and ask again when the app comes back

title: The free month starts again after the app is removed and installed again
what: The day the free month started is kept only on the phone. Removing the app and installing it again, or clearing its data in Android settings, gives a new free month with every paid feature open. Nothing on the server or in the member's MettleUp account remembers it.
expected: Each person gets one free month, as the help says, kept with their MettleUp account where they have one.
who: people without a gym who know the trick
how_often: whenever someone reinstalls, once the paid plan is switched on
fix_line: Keep the free month's start day with the member's account

title: A yearly Plus buyer on a new phone is told they pay every month
what: Google Play does not say whether a running plan is monthly or yearly, so the app remembers which one this phone bought. On a new phone, or after the app's data is cleared, I already paid finds the plan but the app guesses monthly. The MettleUp Plus page and Settings then say You have MettleUp Plus, paid every month, to someone who paid for a year.
expected: When the app cannot tell, it says the member has MettleUp Plus without naming monthly or yearly.
who: yearly buyers who change phone or clear data
how_often: every restore on a new phone, once payments are live
fix_line: Leave out the month or year words when the app does not know

items.reason: Money in this area: the MettleUp Plus page (prices from Google Play, else 149, 999 and 2,499 rupees from the one shared list; no other page shows them), the free month pop-ups under the tabs, the older-charts lock on Profile, Find my gym, and the Workout tab plan-ends card. No receipt, refund, GST or credits wallet here; the Credits page lists picture and font makers, not money. The Gym tab, invite and check-in routes only re-export shop screens (other areas). The plan-ends card says renew at the front desk even at gyms that take payments in the app: same fault as FN-L5-phone-shop-2-03. Promise P-A7-help-1-45 (one free month) is not kept on reinstall.

Store builds: buying is off until the payments-live switch, and the Plus and Find my gym pages leave at once while Plus is off, so no price or Buy button shows. QA builds use a stand-in store that says Test build, buying here takes no money, on the page and in the question. Purchases are trusted on the phone with no server check; the code says that comes with payments live.

Plus: cancelled, failed and unavailable each get their own words; pending says Plus opens when Google Play confirms, but a late confirmation never reaches the app and owned plans are re-read only at a fresh start (also misses cancel and refund mid-run). Gym plan: a cancelled plan is left out by the server, an ended plan hides the Workout card and the Gym tab says Your plan has ended; offline keeps the last answer; a plan sold for later hides the card whether or not it is paid (the member app shows no dues here).

Plus prices: one shared list (149, 999, 2,499) used by the buttons and the tests; Google Play's own price replaces it when known. The gym plan end date on the Workout card comes from the same server answer as the Gym tab, with the same 7-day window. The paid-plan words can say monthly to a yearly buyer after a restore.
